reviews.author: Andy Shevchenko
reviews.summary: Reviewed the patch and found it to be technically sound, with no issues or concerns.
reviews.raw_body:
On Wed, Oct 28, 2026 at 10:20 AM Dmitry Ilvokhin <d@ilvokhin.com> wrote:
>
> Commit 22302af28d3f ("cleanup: Annotate guard constructors with
> nonnull") added the macro __nonnull_args() to wrap raw compiler
> attribute.
>
> Replace __attribute__((nonnull)) with __nonnull_args() to standardize
> nonnull attribute usage across the tree and keep the attribute's quirks
> in one place rather than open-coded at every call site.

Reviewed-by: Andy Shevchenko <andy@kernel.org>

-- 
With Best Regards,
Andy Shevchenko

reviews.author: Jani Nikula
reviews.summary: Acked the patch, indicating that it meets the necessary technical standards for inclusion.
reviews.raw_body:
On Wed, 28 Oct 2026, Dmitry Ilvokhin <d@ilvokhin.com> wrote:
> Commit 22302af28d3f ("cleanup: Annotate guard constructors with
> nonnull") added the macro __nonnull_args() to wrap raw compiler
> attribute.
>
> Replace __attribute__((nonnull)) with __nonnull_args() to standardize
> nonnull attribute usage across the tree and keep the attribute's quirks
> in one place rather than open-coded at every call site.
>
> Suggested-by: Miguel Ojeda <miguel.ojeda.sandonis@gmail.com>
> Signed-off-by: Dmitry Ilvokhin <d@ilvokhin.com>

Acked-by: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>

> ---
>  drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gem/i915_gem_object.h | 4 ++--
>  drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_request.h        | 4 ++--
>  2 files changed, 4 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)
>
> diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gem/i915_gem_object.h b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gem/i915_gem_object.h
> index a2f4b6758a65..648d0b4139cf 100644
> --- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gem/i915_gem_object.h
> +++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gem/i915_gem_object.h
> @@ -127,7 +127,7 @@ __deprecated
>  struct drm_gem_object *
>  drm_gem_object_lookup(struct drm_file *file, u32 handle);
>  
> -__attribute__((nonnull))
> +__nonnull_args()
>  static inline struct drm_i915_gem_object *
>  i915_gem_object_get(struct drm_i915_gem_object *obj)
>  {
> @@ -135,7 +135,7 @@ i915_gem_object_get(struct drm_i915_gem_object *obj)
>  	return obj;
>  }
>  
> -__attribute__((nonnull))
> +__nonnull_args()
>  static inline void
>  i915_gem_object_put(struct drm_i915_gem_object *obj)
>  {
> diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_request.h b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_request.h
> index b09135301f39..f559203c332d 100644
> --- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_request.h
> +++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_request.h
> @@ -437,12 +437,12 @@ void i915_request_cancel(struct i915_request *rq, int error);
>  long i915_request_wait_timeout(struct i915_request *rq,
>  			       unsigned int flags,
>  			       long timeout)
> -	__attribute__((nonnull(1)));
> +	__nonnull_args(1);
>  
>  long i915_request_wait(struct i915_request *rq,
>  		       unsigned int flags,
>  		       long timeout)
> -	__attribute__((nonnull(1)));
> +	__nonnull_args(1);
>  #define I915_WAIT_INTERRUPTIBLE	BIT(0)
>  #define I915_WAIT_PRIORITY	BIT(1) /* small priority bump for the request */
>  #define I915_WAIT_ALL		BIT(2) /* used by i915_gem_object_wait() */

-- 
Jani Nikula, Intel
